# Policies

Payment is split into two parts: 50% at project start and 50% on delivery.

We do not store client customer data after a workflow run completes.

Support requests are answered within one business day.

# Services

We build workflow automations for small businesses, including email, WhatsApp, accounts payable and accounts receivable.

A typical project takes two to four weeks, from requirements to deployment.

We offer a monthly support plan that covers monitoring, fixes and small changes to existing workflows.
